## Activity Rules
How to Participate
1.Log in to your KuCoin account
2.Complete identity verification (KYC)
3.Reach the required cumulative eligible Spot trading volume during the campaign period to earn Lucky Draw entries.
Event Rules
During the campaign period, eligible users who reach the specified cumulative eligible Spot trading volume milestones will earn Lucky Draw entries accordingly.
Lucky Draw entries are awarded cumulatively. Each time you reach a new trading volume milestone, you will receive the corresponding additional entries on top of those already earned.
Each Lucky Draw entry gives you one chance to win a randomly assigned prize, including BTC, an End-of-Year KuCoin Gift Box, or Spot Fee Coupons. Winning a prize is subject to the Lucky Draw result.
Lucky Draw Entry Rewards
- Reach 200 USDT in cumulative eligible Spot trading volume to earn 1 Lucky Draw entry (1 entry in total).
- Reach 1,000 USDT to earn 1 additional Lucky Draw entry (2 entries in total).
- Reach 4,000 USDT to earn 2 additional Lucky Draw entries (4 entries in total).
- Reach 10,000 USDT to earn 2 additional Lucky Draw entries (6 entries in total).
- Reach 40,000 USDT to earn 2 additional Lucky Draw entries (8 entries in total).
Note: Spot Lucky Draw entries are awarded cumulatively. Each milestone grants additional entries on top of those already earned. A maximum of 8 Spot Lucky Draw entries can be earned through this campaign. No additional entries will be granted for cumulative eligible Spot trading volume exceeding 40,000 USDT.
Attention
1.Total rewards pool: 100,000 USDT (First come, first served)
2.The spot trading fee voucher offers a 10% discount and has a validity period of 7 days
3.Eligibility: This campaign is only open to users who meet the campaign eligibility requirements. Sharing or forwarding the campaign page does not automatically grant other users eligibility to participate.
## Eligible Trading Pairs:
Eligible trading pairs for the event include all spot trading pairs, except stablecoin trading pairs (e.g. USDC-USDT, USDT-USDC, USDT-DAI, PYUSD-USDT, USDD-USDT, USDE-USDT, USD1-USDT, TUSD-USDT, USDD-USDC, USDP-USDT)
Terms and Conditions
1. Trading amount = buys + sells;
2. Trading volume = (buys + sells) x price, converted into USDT.
3. Only spot trading orders with a commission greater than 0 will be counted;
4. Rewards are limited and will be distributed on a first-come, first-served basis. The campaign may end early if the prize pool is exhausted.
5. Users who meet the applicable trading volume requirements for the Grand Lucky Draw are eligible to receive additional draw chances. Eligible users can access their entries directly from the Grand Lucky Draw tab on this campaign page. The Grand Lucky Draw operates independently of the Spot Lucky Draw. The maximum limit of 8 entries applies only to the Spot Lucky Draw and does not affect the number of entries users can earn for the Grand Lucky Draw.
6. Rewards will be distributed within 10 working days after the campaign ends;
7. Physical prize winners will be contacted within 14 business days after the campaign ends. In certain circumstances, prizes may be distributed in USDT instead of physical items. Please refer to https://www.kucoin.com/support/48142946142301
8. This activity is only valid for Spot Users with VIP level no more than 4. Market maker accounts and Institutional accounts cannot participate in this activity;
9. If users have doubts about the result of the activities, please note the official appeal period is 2 months after the end of the campaign;
10. For any duplicate or fake accounts found to be cheating or attempting to conduct fraudulent behaviors, the platform will withhold the distribution of the rewards;
11. For any manipulations attempting to get the rewards illegally, the violators will be deprived of the qualification for the rewards;
12. All participants must strictly comply with KuCoin Terms of Use. KuCoin reserves all rights to the final explanation of the event;
13. The specific prizes and their distribution methods will be determined by the platform based on the participation in the event.
14. Investments in digital assets can be risky. Please carefully evaluate the risks of a product and your risk tolerance based on your own financial circumstances;
15. Apple is not a sponsor or involved in the activity in any manner.

6. The withdrawable profit generated from each Futures Trial Fund voucher is capped at 20% of its face value for Trading Competition rewards.
7. Both Spot and Futures trading volumes will count toward the leaderboard.
8. For more details, please refer to the Terms and Conditions.
## Additional Benefits
1. General Cashback: All eligible users with VIP 0-4 will enjoy 5% commission-sharing on eligible trades during the event.
2. Exclusive New User Rewards: New users who register for a KuCoin account using ChartControl AI's broker referral code (R-code) and complete the following tasks can unlock exclusive rewards:
## 💰One-Time Deposit Bonus:
New users who register, complete KYC within 14 days, and deposit at least 50 USDT can earn:
- Spot trading fee deduction coupon worth 50 USDT
- Futures trading fee deduction coupon worth 50 USDT
## 💵One-Time Tiered Trade Bonus:
New users who register, complete KYC and deposit within 14 days, and reach the following Spot + Futures trading volumes can unlock corresponding rewards:
- Trading volume ≥ 1,000 USDT: Interest-Free Coupon worth 50 USDT
- Trading volume ≥ 5,000 USDT: VIP3 benefits voucher
- Trading volume ≥ 10,000 USDT: Futures trading fee deduction coupon worth 200 USDT
- Trading volume ≥ 40,000 USDT: Futures trial fund worth 50 USDT
- Trading volume ≥ 100,000 USDT: Futures trial fund worth 150 USDT
## Terms and Conditions
1. Participation: Log in to your KuCoin account, click the [Register] button on the event page, and allow KuCoin to track your trading volume.
2. Eligible Users: Users registered via ChartControl AI's Broker referral code or using the terminal of ChartControl AI;
3. Market makers are not eligible to participate in this activity.
4. To ensure fair participation, we limit each user to one event per type during the same period. Users will receive the message "You are already enrolled in a similar event..." when participating in multiple events. Thanks for your understanding!
## 5. Eligible Trades:
a) Only trades executed via ChartControl AI's terminal or by users who registered using ChartControl AI's R-code will be counted in this event;
b) Trading volume from zero-fee pairs, negative-fee pairs, and market makers will not be counted in this event.
6. Reward Distribution
- Trading Competition Rewards: Rewards will be distributed within 7 business days after the event ends.
- New User Rewards: Rewards will be distributed within 3 business days after users complete the corresponding tasks.
- Trade Cashback: Cashback will be automatically settled on a T+1 basis and is available exclusively to eligible VIP 0–VIP 4 users.
The cashback amount is calculated by multiplying the applicable cashback rate by the net trading fees for each eligible transaction.
Net Trading Fees refer to the actual trading fees paid by the user after deducting any counterparty rebates, fee discounts, and amounts offset through vouchers, coupons, or other applicable benefits.
7. Reward Usage Rules
- Spot and Futures Trading Fee Deduction Coupons: These coupons can offset up to 10% of the trading fee for each eligible transaction.
- Interest-Free Coupons: These coupons can offset up to 10% of the interest incurred from margin trading. For more details, please refer to the Interest-Free Coupon Instructions(https://www.kucoin.com/support/22328384440473).
- Futures Trial Funds: These funds can be used for Futures trading. The withdrawable profit generated from each Futures Trial Fund voucher is capped at 10% of its face value for New User Rewards and 20% of its face value for Trading Competition Rewards. For more details, please refer to the Futures Trial Fund Guide(https://www.kucoin.com/support/25463084736025).
- VIP Benefits Vouchers: These vouchers can temporarily upgrade a user's VIP level during the voucher's validity period. For more details, please refer to the VIP Benefits Vouchers Instructions(https://www.kucoin.com/support/22926465697817).
8. The sub-accounts will be treated as part of the master account.
9. All participants must strictly comply with KuCoin's Terms of Use.
10. KuCoin reserves the right to the final interpretation of this promotion's terms and conditions. Users found engaging in dishonest activities (e.g., wash trading, bulk account registrations, self-dealing, or market manipulation) may be disqualified from rewards.
11. In case of any discrepancy between the translated version and the original English version, the English version will take precedence.
12. Apple Inc. is not a sponsor and is not affiliated with this event.
## About ChartControl AI
ChartControl AI (https://chartcontrol.cloud) is a non-custodial AI trading terminal for KuCoin. Traders connect their own KuCoin account, and every order is one they place or set up themselves — ChartControl AI never holds funds and charges no trading fees.
By talking with CCAI, the built-in AI, traders turn their own ideas into indicators, signal rules and algorithmic strategies, refine them step by step, and see them drawn directly on the chart. They can backtest those strategies and run them as automated, rule-based (quant) trading on their own account — or trade by hand straight from the chart, including one-click market orders on the live price line.
ChartControl AI never earns from its users' losses.
